guidance.headline: Phase 45 runs first, alone, in the main folder. Then Phases 46 to 49 run in two lanes at once: paste the Lane A prompt into one session and the Lane B prompt into another.
guidance.headline_sub: 45 builds the Contracts section and the Contract page that every later phase builds on, so nothing runs beside it. Once 45 is DONE and committed on master, Lane A builds 46 then 49 and Lane B builds 47 then 48, each in its own worktree (docs/build-plan/LANES.md). The lane that finishes second joins them onto master; then test all four together on 5173.

safe.45: Depends on nothing; it is the base for 46 to 49, so it runs alone in the main folder with its own kick-off prompt.

wait.46: Lane A, after 45 is DONE on master.
wait.47: Lane B, after 45 is DONE on master.
wait.48: Lane B, after 47 (in the same lane).
wait.49: Lane A, after 46 (in the same lane).

guidance.parallel: Wave 1 of the lanes: Lane A 46 then 49, Lane B 47 then 48. Neither lane needs the other's work; they meet only in the Contract list screen, the Contracts route block and shared barrels, as LANES.md's ownership table says. Paste each lane's prompt again whenever its session ends: the same prompt starts, resumes and joins.
